metadata.question: Does the total number of lakes in northern Siberia east of the Taz River decrease in 2002 compared to 1973?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- 1973: Landsat 1-3 MSS (LANDSAT/LM01/LM02/LM03 C02 T1), summer season (1973-06-15 to 1973-09-15). Region: Northern Siberia east of the Taz River approximated as a polygon [lon 80E to 120E, lat 66N to 74N].
- 2002: Landsat 7 ETM+ Level-2 SR (LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2), same summer window (2002-06-15 to 2002-09-15). Fallback windows: 1972-1974 and 2001-2003.
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- 1973 MSS: no QA cloud band; use median composite to reduce clouds (no explicit masking).
- 2002 ETM+: mask clouds/shadows/snow/cirrus using QA_PIXEL bits; compute median NDWI composite.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check image collection sizes; if 0 even after fallback => C1.
- Check valid NDWI pixel counts after masking; if 0 => C2.
- Otsu threshold/histogram returns null/NaN => C3.
- Catch any dataset/band/memory errors => D.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
      [80.0, 66.0], [120.0, 66.0], [120.0, 74.0], [80.0, 74.0], [80.0, 66.0]
    ]], null, false);
    const summer1973 = ['1973-06-15', '1973-09-15'];
    const summer2002 = ['2002-06-15', '2002-09-15'];
    const fb1973 = ['1972-06-15', '1974-09-15'];
    const fb2002 = ['2001-06-15', '2003-09-15'];
    const minLakeArea = 5e4; // 0.05 km2
    const countScale = 120;  // analysis scale for labels/counting components

    // Helper: Otsu threshold on NDWI
    function otsuThreshold(ndwi, geom, scale) {
      const histDict = ndwi.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.histogram(256, -1, 1),
        geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e13, bestEffort: true
      });
      const h = ee.Dictionary(histDict.get('NDWI'));
      return ee.Algorithms.If(h,
        (function() {
          const means = ee.Array(h.get('bucketMeans'));
          const counts = ee.Array(h.get('histogram'));
          const total = ee.Number(counts.reduce('sum', [0]).get([0]));
          const sumAll = ee.Number(means.multiply(counts).reduce('sum', [0]).get([0]));
          const n = counts.length().get([0]);
          const idxs = ee.List.sequence(0, ee.Number(n).subtract(1));
          const init = ee.Dictionary({wB: 0, sumB: 0, varMax: -1, th: 0});
          const result = ee.Dictionary(idxs.iterate(function(i, prev) {
            prev = ee.Dictionary(prev);
            const wi = ee.Number(counts.get([i]));
            const mi = ee.Number(means.get([i]));
            const wB2 = ee.Number(prev.get('wB')).add(wi);
            const sumB2 = ee.Number(prev.get('sumB')).add(wi.multiply(mi));
            const wF = total.subtract(wB2);
            // Avoid division by zero
            const condValid = wB2.gt(0).and(wF.gt(0));
            const mB = ee.Number(ee.Algorithms.If(wB2.gt(0), sumB2.divide(wB2), 0));
            const mF = ee.Number(ee.Algorithms.If(wF.gt(0), sumAll.subtract(sumB2).divide(wF), 0));
            const between = ee.Number(ee.Algorithms.If(condValid, wB2.multiply(wF).multiply(mB.subtract(mF).pow(2)), 0));
            const better = between.gt(ee.Number(prev.get('varMax')));
            const th2 = ee.Number(ee.Algorithms.If(better, mi, prev.get('th')));
            const varMax2 = ee.Number(ee.Algorithms.If(better, between, prev.get('varMax')));
            return ee.Dictionary({wB: wB2, sumB: sumB2, varMax: varMax2, th: th2});
          }, init));
          return ee.Number(result.get('th'));
        })(),
        null
      );
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    // 1973 MSS
    function getMSSCol(start, end) {
      const lm1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LM01/C02/T1');
      const lm2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LM02/C02/T1');
      const lm3 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LM03/C02/T1');
      return lm1.merge(lm2).merge(lm3)
        .filterBounds(region).filterDate(start, end);
    }
    let col1973 = getMSSCol(summer1973[0], summer1973[1]);
    let size1973 = await col1973.size().getInfo();
    if (size1973 === 0) {
      col1973 = getMSSCol(fb1973[0], fb1973[1]);
      size1973 = await col1973.size().getInfo();
    }
    if (size1973 === 0) {
      console.log('1973 MSS Images: 0');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 2002 ETM+ L2
    function getL7Col(start, end) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(region).filterDate(start, end);
    }
    let col2002 = getL7Col(summer2002[0], summer2002[1]);
    let size2002 = await col2002.size().getInfo();
    if (size2002 === 0) {
      col2002 = getL7Col(fb2002[0], fb2002[1]);
      size2002 = await col2002.size().getInfo();
    }
    if (size2002 === 0) {
      console.log(`1973 MSS Images: ${size1973}`);
      console.log('2002 L7 Images: 0');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`1973 MSS Images: ${size1973}`);
    console.log(`2002 L7 Images: ${size2002}`);

    // 3. Processing: NDWI composites
    // MSS NDWI composite (median, no explicit cloud mask)
    const mssNDWIcol = col1973.map(function(img) {
      const ndwi = img.select(['B1', 'B4']).toFloat();
      const g = ndwi.select('B1');
      const n = ndwi.select('B4');
      const nd = g.subtract(n).divide(g.add(n)).rename('NDWI');
      return nd.copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
    });
    const ndwi1973 = mssNDWIcol.median().rename('NDWI');

    // L7 NDWI composite with QA mask
    function l7Ndwi(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 0).eq(0) // fill
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0))     // dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))     // cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))     // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))     // cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0));    // snow
      const scale = 0.0000275, offset = -0.2;
      const green = img.select('SR_B2').multiply(scale).add(offset);
      const nir = img.select('SR_B4').multiply(scale).add(offset);
      const nd = green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).rename('NDWI');
      return nd.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
    }
    const l7NDWIcol = col2002.map(l7Ndwi);
    const ndwi2002 = l7NDWIcol.median().rename('NDWI');

    // Pixel validation counts and cloud %
    const totalPixels = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('one');
    const totalCount2002 = await totalPixels.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e13, bestEffort: true
    }).get('one').getInfo();
    const validCount1973 = await ndwi1973.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e13, bestEffort: true
    }).get('NDWI').getInfo();
    const validCount2002 = await ndwi2002.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e13, bestEffort: true
    }).get('NDWI').getInfo();

    console.log(`1973 NDWI valid px: ${validCount1973 || 0}`);
    console.log(`2002 NDWI valid px: ${validCount2002 || 0} (cloud%~${totalCount2002 ? ((1 - (validCount2002 / totalCount2002)) * 100).toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%)`);

    if (!validCount1973 || validCount1973 === 0 || !validCount2002 || validCount2002 === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Thresholding via Otsu
    const th1973 = ee.Number(otsuThreshold(ndwi1973, region, 500));
    const th2002 = ee.Number(otsuThreshold(ndwi2002, region, 500));
    const th1973v = await th1973.getInfo();
    const th2002v = await th2002.getInfo();
    if (th1973v === null || th2002v === null || isNaN(th1973v) || isNaN(th2002v)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    console.log(`1973 Otsu NDWI: ${th1973v.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`2002 Otsu NDWI: ${th2002v.toFixed(3)}`);

    // 5. Water masks and lake counting (connected components, area >= 0.05 km2)
    function lakeCount(ndwiImg, thr) {
      const water = ndwiImg.gt(thr).selfMask();
      const labels = water.connectedComponents(ee.Kernel.square(1), 65535).select('labels');
      const compArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().addBands(labels)
        .reduceConnectedComponents({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), labelBand: 'labels', maxSize: 65535 });
      const large = labels.updateMask(compArea.gte(minLakeArea));
      const count = large.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.countDistinct(), geometry: region, scale: countScale, maxPixels: 1e13, bestEffort: true
      }).get('labels');
      return count;
    }
    const lakes1973 = await lakeCount(ndwi1973, th1973).getInfo();
    const lakes2002 = await lakeCount(ndwi2002, th2002).getInfo();

    if (lakes1973 === null || lakes2002 === null || isNaN(lakes1973) || isNaN(lakes2002)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const delta = lakes2002 - lakes1973;
    const pct = lakes1973 > 0 ? (delta / lakes1973) * 100 : null;
    console.log(`Lakes>=0.05km²: 1973=${lakes1973}, 2002=${lakes2002}, Δ=${delta}${pct !== null ? ` (${pct.toFixed(1)}%)` : ''}`);

    // 6. Final Answer
    if (lakes1973 === 0 && lakes2002 === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
    } else if (lakes2002 < lakes1973) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
